coreMemory.english: n. the act of carefully noticing something
coreMemory.structure: pay attention to /peɪ əˈtenʃən tu/（注意……）；draw attention to /drɔ əˈtenʃən tu/（使人注意……）；get someone’s attention /ɡɛt someone’s əˈtenʃən/（引起某人注意）；full attention /fʊl əˈtenʃən/（全部注意力）
coreMemory.commonError: ❌ use attention with the same article in every context → ✅ check the countability of attention in context；❌ translate attention word by word → ✅ learn the complete phrase “pay attention to”

commonErrors.wrong: use attention with the same article in every context
commonErrors.wrongPhonetic: /jus əˈtenʃən wɪð ðə seɪm ɑrtəkəl ɪn ɛvɚi kɑntɛkst/
commonErrors.right: check the countability of attention in context
commonErrors.rightPhonetic: /tʃɛk ðə countability ʌv əˈtenʃən ɪn kɑntɛkst/
commonErrors.note: 同一个名词在不同义项下可能有可数、不可数或单复数差异，不能机械套用冠词。

commonErrors.right: learn the complete phrase “pay attention to”
commonErrors.rightPhonetic: /lɝn ðə kəmplit freɪz peɪ əˈtenʃən tu/
commonErrors.note: 不要只按中文逐字替换；优先把本卡高频搭配作为完整句块记忆。
